answer: Registration locks a vote-escrowed stake that cannot move as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. An agent caught operating many identities from one funding source is exposed by graph analysis of funding flows. The penalty follows at once: the slash doubles for each repeat offence within sixteen epochs. No identity exists without its own terrace of locked funds. A farm needs a fresh vine per fake, each costing a full bond. The walnut is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
